upstream.description: Bootstraps a fresh Ubuntu VPS into a complete multi-agent AI development environment in 30 minutes: coding agents, session management, safety tools, and coordination infrastructure

classification.analysis: Agentic Coding Flywheel Setup (ACFS) is a one-liner curl-to-bash installer that turns a fresh Ubuntu VPS into a fully configured multi-agent AI coding environment in about 30 minutes. It installs and wires up three coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI), a modern shell (zsh/oh-my-zsh/p10k), language runtimes, and a suite of agent-coordination utilities (NTM, MCP Agent Mail, SLB) plus an onboarding curriculum for beginners. It is manifest-driven (a single YAML source of truth generates installer scripts and doctor checks) and ships an accompanying wizard website for non-technical users to rent a VPS and SSH in. Aimed at solo builders and small teams who want a reproducible, idempotent agentic-coding VPS without hand-configuring tools one by one.

use_cases.title: Spin up a fresh VPS pre-configured for AI coding agents in one command
Standardize a team's agentic dev environment so every box is identical
Onboard a non-technical beginner to agent-assisted coding via a guided wizard
Wire up coordination tooling (NTM, MCP Agent Mail) for multiple agents working in parallel
